name: lokatalenta-sprint-planner
description: LokaTalenta Sprint Planner: capacity planning across 6 divisions & 24 agents, Backlog integration, ceremony notes, velocity/burndown analytics, and real-time Event Gateway telemetry.

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.build:client: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.lint: oxlint server api tests && npm --prefix client run lint
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p server/tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.api.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit && npm --prefix client run typecheck
